mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 81 degrees under clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park, though keep in mind the air quality index is currently at a moderate 58.

Starting Tuesday, August 18, road construction begins on Highway M west of the Highway PB intersection. Traffic will shift into the westbound lanes for phase one, so expect one lane of travel in each direction for the next two to three weeks. Also, the City Plan Commission has an agenda set for September 8th regarding site plans for 201 South Main Street and the Sub-Zero project.

There is plenty to do in town! Today, you can catch trivia at both Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, there is more trivia at Paddy Mac's, The Mill, and The Bogey Factory, plus live music and yoga options. Don't forget the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market is also happening tomorrow at Hometown Junction Park.
In a recent report, on August 6, an officer observed a vehicle speeding and driving erratically. The driver, a 49-year-old man, was found to be impaired and was arrested for his fourth O W I offence.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the delectable Chocolate Heath Crunch. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
